items.title: RCNi Nursing Leadership Summit: Migraine and Headache, London, 30 October 2026
items.summary: In-person day at RCN HQ London for nurses in migraine, headache and neurology care, with expert-led learning and nurse-led service development examples. Organised by RCNi, sponsored by Teva UK, with a promotional stand. Expression of interest required and places are not guaranteed.

items.title: Dementia care needs same ambition as cancer, argues report
items.summary: Dementia needs the same investment that has transformed cancer survival in recent decades if any real progress is to be made, a report has concluded. The King’s Fund and Alzheimer’s Society said dementia care is stuck in the 20th century and needs a ‘cancer-style revolution’.

items.title: Best practice pathway for transient loss of consciousness (TLoC) in over-16s
items.summary: GIRFT has published a best practice pathway for managing transient loss of consciousness in adults, intended to standardise assessment and reduce unnecessary admissions.

items.title: Migraine and acne amid conditions added to Pharmacy First scheme
items.summary: Five new areas have been added to the Pharmacy First scheme, with eligible pharmacies now able to prescribe medications for acne and migraine.

items.title: Early statin use linked to lower dementia risk in type 2 diabetes
items.summary: Early use of statins after a type 2 diabetes diagnosis could reduce the risk of developing dementia, new research suggests. Researchers at Copenhagen University Hospital analysed Danish health records for 132,585 people with type 2 diabetes, comparing dementia rates according to when they began statin treatment.
